primary.title: ITR-6 Excel utility for AY 2026-27 released: Eligibility, due dates, key documents explained
primary.summary: The Income Tax Department has released the Excel utility for ITR-6 for AY 2026-27. The utility is now available on the e-Filing portal. The form is applicable to companies that are not claiming exemption under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act.
